name: Sheffield Spring - British Blind Off 2023

venue.name: The Diamond, University of Sheffield
venue.details: Workroom 2, Ground Floor, by West Entrance

information: **PLEASE NOTE:** This is a Blindfolded specialist competition. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. We will be holding 6x6 and 7x7 in addition, but we still regard this as a blindfolded specialist competition. The winner of 3x3 Blindfolded will be announced as the winner of the competition. [![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/OXOffhf.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)
